title: Form Energy hero
description: A full-bleed video hero under a 2px orange rule: a huge white uppercase condensed headline with airy tracking low on the frame, and a lead paragraph set off by a thin orange vertical rule, over a soft dark diagonal shade. Fixed content height (535px on phones, 758px on desktop), not window-sized.
notes: a .dark scope: white text on a black ground under any theme
media fills the whole hero like object-fit: cover; empty, it is a dark placeholder
leave room for an overlay header: put formenergy-header and the hero in one relative wrapper (the header is a sibling so its phone menu is not clipped)
each titleLines entry is one line on desktop; on phones the words wrap freely
name: formenergy-hero

props.name: titleLines
props.description: the headline, one entry per desktop line (shown uppercase)

props.name: lead
props.description: the lead paragraph beside the orange rule

props.name: media
props.description: a video or image filling the hero (cover); a dark placeholder when empty
